semantic: Radius-space area bonus for the Necrotic Mortar cast by Skeleton Mages (also Cryomancer/Pyromancer variants). Chain: SummonMageMutator -> Base/SummonSkeletonMageMutator(+0x148) -> SkeletonMageAdapter(+0x9C) -> NecroticMortarMutator.increasedRadius(+0x128) -> NecroticMortarAoEMutator.increasedRadius(+0x120). NecroticMortarAoEMutator.Mutate: R = Maths.GetIncreasedRadiusAfterAdditiveAreaIncrease(f, A) = sqrt((1+f)^2 + A) - 1, where A = mage's Stats.GetIncreasedAreaForAreaSkill(abilityTags) (additive area increase); if R != 0 the CreateVfxOnDeath scales (+0x24/+0x28) are set to R and the area-scale virtual method is applied to the mortar object.
formula: mortar radius multiplier = 1 + R = sqrt((1+f)^2 + A_mage), f = sqrt(1 + 0.2*p) - 1 per tree (p points, max 2) so (1+f)^2 = 1 + 0.2p, i.e. +20% increased AREA per point additive with the mage's own increased area stats A (area multiplier = 1 + 0.2p + A). Radius scales with sqrt of area.
notes: tree value already sqrt(1+0.2p)-1. Code only sets adapter usesFireMortar (pyro) / usesColdMortar (cryo); adapter.usesNecroticMortar (0x99) is never set in code, so for plain skeleton mage/DK the radius applies only if the prefab adapter has that flag.
